title: Thoracic FSU NZ by disc degeneration grade 2, pooled levels (Liebsch 2022)

quantity.name: NZ
quantity.definition: NZ (turning point of moment-angle curve) per direction, 3rd cycle; boxplot statistics: median (solid line), mean (dashed), q1/q3 (box), min/max (whisker caps). pct_vs_grade0/1 = relative changes printed in the figure.

source.sample: 13 of 95 human thoracic FSUs (T1-T2..T11-T12 pooled, 33 donors) with disc degeneration grade 2 (Liebsch x-ray grading; 0 none, 1 mild, 2 moderate); FSUs with costovertebral and costotransverse joints and >=2 cm ribs
source.sex: whole collective: 18 M / 15 F donors; 67 FSUs male, 28 female

protocol.summary: Monosegmental thoracic FSUs (rib heads, costovertebral/costotransverse joints, >=2 cm ribs), pure moments in FE, LB, AR at 1 deg/s, 3.5 cycles (3rd evaluated). 47 FSUs (donors 1-25) were loaded to 7.5 Nm and 48 FSUs (donors 26-33) to 5 Nm; ROM evaluated at 5 Nm for all.
how_to_simulate: Model a thoracic FSU with costovertebral/costotransverse joints and 2 cm rib stumps, disc properties per degeneration grade
Fix caudal vertebra, apply pure moment to 5 Nm (or 7.5 Nm, read at 5 Nm), no preload
Report rotation at 5 Nm (and NZ) per direction
protocol.notes: Pooled over all thoracic levels. Overlap: the 48 FSUs of donors 26-33 = Liebsch 2020 Spine J FSUs (= monosegments of the Liebsch 2020 rib cage specimens); the 47 FSUs of donors 1-25 (7.5 Nm) are probably from the Wilke 2017 series. Both feed Wilke 2025. Printed % changes were only partly reproduced from the digitised lines (medians vs means ambiguous) - see check_notes.

extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.1 deg ROM (19.9 px/deg), +/-0.05 deg NZ (41 px/deg); solid-vs-dashed line assignment uncertain where lines are close
extraction.check_notes: Automated detection of box borders, solid/dashed lines and whisker caps; NZ extension grade 2 median corrected manually (coincides with q1). Printed % changes are reproduced better by the dashed lines in some panels (e.g. left AR) - treat median/mean labels with caution.

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: rib heads with costovertebral and costotransverse joints, >=2 cm ribs
